statement: Structure-sheaf direct images, fixed gamma subbundle, finite eigencharacters, and cusp cup product in the form used here.

notes: Independent determinant-line derivation: the vertical quotient has twelfth power Delta inverse with one cusp pole, hence root line R^(-1); duality and exact cyclic invariants give the coarse O(-1). No reliance on AC26 Proposition 9.13.

statement: Logarithmic cotangent bundles are locally free at all strata; det E=omega_f(-2S1-3S2) and 0->det E->E->O->0.
notes: Includes both triple points, all double curves and finite etale descent.

statement: Rq E=(O+O(-1),O^2+O(-1)^2,O+O(-1)) by O(2S1+3S2) and fibrewise duality.
notes: Independent global method: vertical line-bundle upper modifications followed by duality, not the workbench tensor-lattice filtration.
